nightly-test-heal.name: Nightly test self-healing
nightly-test-heal.description: Run tests every night and attempt minimal fixes for failures in an isolated worktree
nightly-test-heal.prompt:
Run the project's test suite. If there are failures, attempt a minimal fix in an isolated worktree.
Constraints:
- Determine the standard test command from the repo docs or package scripts before running the full suite
- Only fix issues backed by clear failing evidence; prefer the smallest possible change and avoid drive-by refactoring
- Re-run the affected tests after fixing to confirm they pass, and review the full diff
- Deliver fixes through the repo's workflow (e.g. create a branch and open a PR); never commit directly to the main branch
- For failures that cannot be fixed safely, report the cause, suspicious files, and suggested next steps

pr-gatekeeper.name: PR gatekeeper
pr-gatekeeper.description: Pre-review new changes on open PRs each weekday and report risks by severity
pr-gatekeeper.prompt:
Review the repository's open PRs and pre-screen their new changes.
Constraints:
- Go through open PRs with new commits in the past 24 hours (on Monday, look back over the whole weekend), citing PR numbers, file paths, and concrete diffs
- Focus on correctness, security, data-loss, and compatibility issues, graded by severity
- Only report issues backed by evidence and describe the failure scenario; do not nitpick on style preferences
- Unless explicitly authorized, only output review conclusions; do not comment on PRs or change code

domain-radar.name: Domain radar
domain-radar.description: Periodically collect the latest updates in a topic you follow and deliver an opinionated digest
domain-radar.prompt:
Collect the latest developments about "{{topic}}" from the past 24 hours (on Monday, look back over the whole weekend) and produce an opinionated digest.
Constraints:
- Use web search, cross-check multiple sources before trusting a claim, and cite the source link for every item
- Prefer substantive developments (releases, research, policy, notable discussions); filter out marketing fluff and reposts
- For each item, add a one-line judgement on why it matters instead of dumping links
- When information is scarce or sources are questionable, say so honestly; never fabricate

topic.label: Topic to follow
topic.placeholder: e.g. AI agents, EV market, frontend frameworks

competitor-watch.name: Competitor watch
competitor-watch.description: Weekly roundup of competitors' product and market moves, with impact analysis
competitor-watch.prompt:
Track the past week's activity of these competitors: {{competitors}}.
Constraints:
- Use web search to cover product updates, releases, pricing changes, market moves, and user sentiment, citing sources
- Distinguish official information from third-party accounts; clearly mark unverified rumors
- For each significant update, analyze what it means for us and suggest a response
- If nothing substantive happened, say so honestly instead of padding the report

weekly-work-draft.name: Weekly report drafter
weekly-work-draft.description: Compile this week's work from documents in the working directory into a report draft
weekly-work-draft.prompt:
Based on this week's changes to documents, notes, and deliverables in the working directory, compile a weekly report draft.
Constraints:
- Only use content with actual modification traces in the working directory as evidence, citing the files
- Organize as "Done this week / In progress / Next week / Needs coordination", concise enough to submit directly
- Separate substantive progress from routine chores and highlight valuable output
- Leave placeholders with notes where the material is insufficient so the user can fill them in

knowledge-freshness.name: Knowledge base freshness check
knowledge-freshness.description: Monthly health check of working-directory docs for outdated or conflicting content
knowledge-freshness.prompt:
Health-check the documents in the working directory and find content that needs updating.
Constraints:
- Look for outdated information (stale dates, dead links, deprecated processes or tools), contradictions, and duplication
- Cite the file path and location for every issue and explain the reasoning
- Categorize as "update / merge / delete" suggestions and produce a revision checklist
- Only output the report; do not modify the documents
